title: Great experience for sure!!!
text: What a fantastic experience... Xavier was professional, knowledge, and fun. 10/10 for sure!!!  Glad to have booked this experience!
author: teresa_d

title: Outstanding
text: It was the best in what was covered, how it was covered, and the guides personable attitude. I really appreciated the knowledge of the guide and the way he presented the information.
author: Mark_R

title: Faidra was the greatest
text: Our guide, Faidra was so knowledgeable and passionate regarding the sights we viewed.  The depth of her knowledge and details regarding the evolution of Barcelona through the years was amazing. Everything was so beautiful and of course the Basilica was breath taking. One of the most, if not the most memorable tours we have taken.
author: Thomas_S

title: Barcelona with a great guide
text: Xavi (Xavier), our guide,  was truly a gift to us!  He showed us amazing Barcelona with knowledge, enthusiasm and humor. In spite of rain, we were able to see this beautiful city through his eyes and appreciate its culture, architecture and history. We highly recommend this tour and hope you are able to experience it with Xavi or someone as informed and passionate as he is!
author: Cherchez1

title: Barcelona Tour Gothic, Sagrada Familia & Park Guell
text: Marta made this tour of Barcelona come to life!  She was amazing.  Friendly, warm and so very knowledgeable.  Park Guell and Sagrada Familia were the highlights of our recent trip to Barcelona.  We were completely amazed at Gaudi's talent and imagination.  So much so, that we took the Casa Batllo tour the next day.   Special thanks to Marta who made this tour such a memorable one!!!
author: Mark_M

title: Nuria was a great guide -...
text:
Nuria was a great guide - explaining both the history, with her personal flavor added as a born and raised resident of the area. Highly recommend the tour - included a lot more than we expected, including a walk through the old town. Would recommend to all. 

Useful Note: the entry tickets for the Sagrada Familia and Park Guell are secured in advance, however you will be expected to pay for them at cost, on top of the cost of the tour.
author: TannerLindahl

title: Tour of Sagrada, Park and Gothic
text: Xavier did an amazing job with the tour from start to finish. His knowledge of the different places we visited was exceptional . He was engaging and a true professional! Without a doubt we would tour with him again.
author: Teresa_F

title: Great tour
text: Gloria was a wonderful tour guide. Full of information. We did a half day tour and it was well worth it!!!
author: Wendy_K

title: Would definitely recommend this trip if you want to see the main things Barcelona has to offer
text: Really good tour, cram packed full of history. Xavier was a great tour guide full of knowledge and very friendly. Would definitely recommend
author: Rebecca_W

title: A must-do!
text: This tour was one of the highlights of our trip. We got to see so much in Barcelona with the added benefit of a very knowledgable tour guide. Faidra was incredible and we were so impressed with her depth of knowledge. We learned so much more about Barcelona than we thought we were going to. This tour was a great value as we had transportation to the Sagrada Familia, Park Guell, and Montjuic. We also walked through the Gothic Quarter and saw all the incredible things it had to offer. I highly recommend this tour to anyone going to Barcelona for the first time, and hopefully you'll be in Faidra'
author: Lindsay_M
